description: Turn pool equipment on or off. iAqua (Jandy iAquaLink) systems: pool_pump, spa_pump, pool_heater, spa_heater, solar_heater. eXO salt chlorinators: filter_pump, production (chlorine generation), boost, low (low-output mode), heating. Reads the current state first and sends nothing if it already matches (iAqua commands are toggles); afterwards re-reads to confirm the change landed. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE).

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

on.description: true = turn on, false = turn off

name: iaqualink_set_equipment
